title: client: pre-bundle chart.js in Vite dev so lazy chart routes render reliably
intent: Vite's dependency optimizer only discovers an import when the module graph reaches it. chart.js is reached exclusively through lazy route chunks, so the dev server discovers it mid-session, re-runs optimizeDeps, and serves a transient 504 'Outdated Optimize Dep' that blanks the first navigation to a chart-bearing route (reported on /calculators). Declaring it in optimizeDeps.include pre-bundles it at dev-server startup instead, which is the conventional Vite remedy for this symptom. Dev-server configuration only.
behavior_change: none in production. vite.config.ts optimizeDeps affects the Vite dev server's dependency pre-bundling only; it does not alter the production rollup build, application logic, routing, or any API contract. Tests are unaffected because packages/client/vitest.config.ts is a standalone vitest/config defineConfig with its own plugins and resolve block - it does not import or extend vite.config.ts, so no optimizeDeps setting reaches the test runner. Observable dev-server effect: a marginally longer cold start in exchange for removing the mid-session re-optimize.

diff_articulation.what_changed: packages/client/vite.config.ts gains an optimizeDeps.include entry for 'chart.js', with a comment recording why the entry exists so it does not later read as arbitrary. The include list is exactly the specifier the codebase imports: all seven chart.js imports in packages/client/src resolve 'chart.js', and no file imports the 'chart.js/auto' subpath, so listing it would pre-bundle a module the app never loads and would assert an import path the codebase does not use. The comment names the three feature areas that actually reach the dependency - the audio analyzer renderers, the acoustics calculator, and multi-run comparison - rather than attributing it to /calculators alone, because /calculators is where the symptom was reported, not the extent of the dependency.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: There is no existing optimizeDeps block in this config; the file previously declared only plugins, resolve.alias and server. This is the first dependency-optimizer directive in the client build, and it addresses a reproducible dev-server failure rather than a style preference.

commands_run: grep -rn "from ['\"]chart\.js" packages/client/src -> 7 hits, all specifier 'chart.js'; zero hits for 'chart.js/auto'
packages/client/vitest.config.ts inspected -> standalone defineConfig from vitest/config; does not import vite.config.ts, so tests are unaffected
